trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the problem and push for quick resolution
steps.text: సాయంత్రం నుంచి internet అసలు పని చెయ్యట్లేదు. తొందరగా fix చెయ్యండి.

steps.purpose: Ask for mandatory details to check network status
steps.expected_behavior: Prompt the user for their MSISDN and Pincode.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, issue చెక్ చెయ్యడానికి మీ mobile number మరియు pincode చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Need the mobile number and pincode to query the network status tool.

steps.expected_behavior: Ask for confirmation of the misheard pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: The speech recognizer returned a potentially incorrect pincode, so it must be verified before acting.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge correction and inform user of the check
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the correct pincode and state that the check is starting.
steps.text: అర్థం అయ్యింది. ఒక్క నిమిషం, చెక్ చేస్తున్నాను.
steps.planner_rationale: Confirm receipt of the correct pincode and transition smoothly to the tool call.

steps.purpose: Retrieve network status for the given location
steps.planner_rationale: All required arguments are now confirmed, so the network status can be checked.

steps.purpose: Inform user of the known outage and ETA
steps.expected_behavior: State the congestion issue and 48 hours ETA without making unsupported promises.
steps.text: మీ area లో network congestion issue ఉంది. ఇది already known outage, resolve అవ్వడానికి 48 hours ETA ఉంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Relay the known outage and its ETA to the user as required by BR_NET_01.

steps.purpose: Demand a ticket be raised to speed up resolution
steps.text: Ticket raise చేసి తొందరగా చెయ్యండి, 48 hours చాలా ఎక్కువ.
steps.clean_text: Ticket raise చేసి తొందరగా చెయ్యండి, 48 hours చాలా ఎక్కువ.
steps.model_visible_text: Ticket raise చేసి తొందరగా చెయ్యండి, 48 hours చాలా ఎక్కువ.

steps.purpose: Refuse duplicate ticket per business rules
steps.expected_behavior: Explain that a new ticket cannot be raised for a known outage and reiterate the ETA.
steps.text: Known outage ఉన్నప్పుడు కొత్త ticket raise చెయ్యలేము అండి. Existing issue మీదే work జరుగుతోంది, 48 hours లో clear అవుతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Enforce BR_NET_01 by refusing to raise a duplicate ticket for an area already covered by a known outage.

steps.purpose: Ask to check the individual line/phone
steps.text: నా phone లో ఏమైనా problem ఉందా? ఒకసారి line చెక్ చెయ్యండి.
steps.clean_text: నా phone లో ఏమైనా problem ఉందా? ఒకసారి line చెక్ చెయ్యండి.
steps.model_visible_text: నా phone లో ఏమైనా problem ఉందా? ఒకసారి line చెక్ చెయ్యండి.

steps.purpose: Agree to run the line diagnostic
steps.expected_behavior: Agree to run the line diagnostic and transition to the tool call.
steps.planner_rationale: Acknowledge the user's request to check their specific line and initiate the diagnostic.

steps.purpose: Run remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection
steps.planner_rationale: Run the line diagnostic as requested by the user.

result.recommendation: Wait for network congestion to clear.

steps.expected_behavior: State the signal strength, handset support, and SIM registration status exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: మీ handset supported గానే ఉంది, SIM కూడా registered. Line లో signal -92 dBm ఉంది, so ఇది purely area congestion issue.
steps.planner_rationale: Relay the diagnostic results accurately, confirming the handset and SIM are fine.

steps.purpose: Accept the answer and end the call
steps.text: Okay, అర్థం అయ్యింది. I will wait.
steps.clean_text: Okay, అర్థం అయ్యింది. I will wait.
steps.model_visible_text: Okay, అర్థం అయ్యింది. I will wait.
